entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A medieval plane of knights, castles and fair folk, inspired by Arthurian legend and European fairy tales, split between the Realm and the Wilds.

entities.name: The Realm
entities.description: The orderly human society of five courts, each with a color, virtue and sacred relic, ruled by the High King.

entities.name: The Wilds
entities.description: The enchanted region of untamed magic beyond the Realm, home to the fair folk.

entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: A knightly court devoted to Loyalty, now in ruin.

entities.name: Embereth
entities.description: A red-aligned court devoted to Courage, home of the Irencrag.

entities.name: Garenbrig
entities.description: A green-aligned court of Strength ruled by the giant King Yorvo.

entities.name: Locthwain
entities.description: A fallen court once devoted to Persistence, centered on the Cauldron of Eternity.

entities.name: Vantress
entities.description: A blue-aligned court of Knowledge, seat of acting king Will Kenrith.

entities.name: Tanglespan
entities.description: A giant chasm created outside Locthwain to trap the Phyrexian invaders.

entities.name: Stormkeld
entities.description: A massive marble castle in the clouds, home of the Giant Beluna, where Indrelon is now kept.

entities.name: Algenus Kenrith
entities.description: The High King of Eldraine, abducted and turned into a stag by Oko, later restored.

entities.name: Linden
entities.description: The Queen who married Algenus and took Rowan and Will as her children.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A twin planeswalker whose spark ignited after learning the truth of her past; later sought magical power.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A twin planeswalker who becomes acting king and later High King after his father.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A planeswalker who abducted the High King and turned him into a stag, stirring up the fey.

entities.name: Ayara
entities.description: Queen of Locthwain, compleated during the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Yorvo
entities.description: The giant king of Garenbrig who escapes his court's devastation.

entities.name: Torbran
entities.description: A character of Red Fell tasked with luring the Phyrexians into the trap.

entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: A character who inadvertently brought the trap plan to fruition.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: The fae Lord of the Wilds who helped cast the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: One of three witch sisters who cast the Wicked Slumber; killed by Kellan.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch sister who coerced Rowan and is captured, ending the curse.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: A witch sister with an ice castle, defeated by Kellan.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who used the slumbering inhabitants' nightmares and boosted Eriette's powers.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A half-Fae quested by Talion to defeat the three witches and lift the curse.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: Kellan's ally who helps him kill Agatha.

entities.name: Questing Beast
entities.description: The being that chooses two candidates each generation to quest for the high rulership.

entities.name: Indrelon
entities.description: The relic of Vantress, a magic mirror that answers a question in exchange for a secret.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: A curse cast on the plane to halt the Phyrexian invasion that later spread to its inhabitants.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Eldraine's courts fell within days.

entities.name: Wild Hunt
entities.description: A hunt through the Wilds that culminated in the stag's death and ritual end.

entities.name: Verdant Order
entities.description: Knights from all five courts who renounced former oaths to defend the last untouched wilds.

entities.name: Council of Druids
entities.description: The closest thing to a ruling body in the Wilds: elves who want the return of elvish rule.

entities.name: Cauldron of Eternity
entities.description: The long-lost relic of Locthwain.

events.summary: Mankind overthrows the Elven Lords who enslaved them on the mesa that became Castle Ardenvale, founding the five courts.
events.quote: mankind took a stand on the mesa that would become Castle Ardenvale and overthrew the Elven Lords that had enslaved them

events.summary: The Questing Beast chooses Algenus Kenrith and Linden to quest for the high rulership.
events.quote: the Questing Beast chose the humble Algenus Kenrith and Linden to quest for the high rulership and gave each a sword as the mark of its favor

events.summary: Algenus completes the High Quest and becomes High King.
events.quote: While Algenus completed the High Quest and became High King

events.summary: Oko abducts the High King and turns him into a stag, around 4561 AR.
events.quote: After the High King was abducted by Oko , the fey, around 4561 AR and turned into a stag

events.summary: The royal twins set out at eighteen to find their father.
events.quote: When the royal twins turned eighteen, they set out on a quest to find their father.

events.summary: Algenus is returned to life with his magical sword, and the twins' planeswalker spark ignites, sending them to a new plane.
events.quote: Learning the truth of their past, the Kenrith twins' shared Planeswalker's spark ignited, sending them across the Blind Eternities to a new plane.

events.summary: Within days of the Phyrexian invasion the courts fall, the Kenriths die and Ayara is compleated.
events.quote: Within days of the Invasion, the courts of the Realm had fallen, the Kenriths were dead, and Ayara had been compleated , along with her guards.

events.summary: Rankle inadvertently completes the trap just as the Phyrexians fall under the Wicked Slumber.
events.quote: Rankle inadvertently brought the plan to fruition just as the Phyrexians fell under the Wicked Slumber .

events.summary: Talion and the three witch sisters cast the Wicked Slumber on the plane to halt the invasion; it does not lift.
events.quote: had cast the Wicked Slumber on the plane to halt the Invasion

events.summary: Will Kenrith takes his father's crown, declaring himself High King.
events.quote: Will Kenrith took up his father's crown, declaring himself High King of the Realm

events.summary: Kellan, with Ruby, kills Agatha and defeats Hylda.
events.quote: Kellan, with the help of Ruby , succeeded in killing Agatha and defeating Hylda.

events.summary: Kellan and Will capture Eriette, ending the curse and reawakening the realm.
events.quote: defeated the villains and captured Eriette, ending the curse and reawakening the realm

events.summary: Knights from all five courts form the Verdant Order.
events.quote: Knights from all five courts joined to form the Verdant Order
